items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...You mentioned John Hammond was there? ... [INTERVIEWEE] No, I don't. ... [INTERVIEWER] John Hammond was the only one? [INTERVIEWEE] Someone else - I can't think of his name.

ctx.x: When did you join Fletcher Henderson's band?
I don't know. Switched around so many times. I have those records back there, too. In fact, I have the whole album and I haven't played one of the records out yet. I went down to John Hammond's ...
What album is that? Fletcher Henderson album,
